tools.name: salesbinder_list_customers
tools.description: Read one visible customer page. Search name, office email or an exact numeric customer number. Requires customers:read. Follow next_page manually; totals are omitted unless requested.

tools.name: salesbinder_get_customer
tools.description: Read a visible customer by UUID, including contact and account summary fields. Requires customers:read.

tools.name: salesbinder_list_items
tools.description: Read one visible inventory page with quantity, reserved/incoming quantity, price and permission-visible cost. Search name, SKU, barcode, serial or an exact numeric item number. Location filtering adds separate location totals. Requires items:read. No stock changes.

tools.name: salesbinder_get_item
tools.description: Read one inventory item by UUID, including archived or sold items visible to the API user. Returns stock and pricing summary; photo galleries and custom fields are omitted. Requires items:read.

tools.name: salesbinder_list_locations
tools.description: Read one page of active inventory locations and their UUIDs. Assigned-location visibility applies. Requires items:read.

tools.name: salesbinder_list_invoices
tools.description: Read one visible invoice page, newest invoice number first, with status and decimal amount summaries. Filter by customer UUID, status ID or issue date. Line items are omitted. Requires invoices:read; no sending or payment operations.

tools.name: salesbinder_list_sales_orders
tools.description: Read one visible sales-order page with status, amount and invoiced/packed/shipped progress. Search or filter by customer, status, warehouse or issue date. Line items are omitted. Requires sales_orders:read; no fulfillment changes.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: salesbinder_list_customers, salesbinder_list_invoices, salesbinder_list_sales_orders · Private data: salesbinder_get_customer · Public sink: salesbinder_list_customers.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: salesbinder_list_customers, salesbinder_list_invoices, salesbinder_list_sales_orders · Private data: salesbinder_get_customer · Public sink: salesbinder_list_customers

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
